{"domain": "study_planning", "initial_request": "I want to understand the steps described in an acoustic drum-tuning lesson. Create a short study-and-practice plan. Start on 2027-02-01. Even if a day has several short sessions, their combined length must stay within 55 minutes. Cover these exact topic labels: \"Lug Sequencing\", \"Head Seating\", \"Resonant Head Tension\". Give each one at least 10 minutes over the whole plan. Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-04, inclusive.", "reference_date": "2027-02-01", "user_control": "continue", "clarifications": [], "field_values": {"deadline": "Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-04, inclusive.", "available_time": "Even if a day has several short sessions, their combined length must stay within 55 minutes.", "topics": "Cover these exact topic labels: \"Lug Sequencing\", \"Head Seating\", \"Resonant Head Tension\".\nGive each one at least 10 minutes over the whole plan.", "priorities": null}, "eligible_fields": ["priorities"], "remaining_question_items": 3, "fields": [{"field_id": "deadline", "label_zh": "截止日", "description_zh": "最后可学习日期，包含当日。起始日始终在初始请求给定。", "question_template": "What is the last date available for study, inclusive?"}, {"field_id": "available_time", "label_zh": "每日时长", "description_zh": "每天可学习的分钟上限。本试跑采用统一每日上限。", "question_template": "How many minutes can you study per day at most?"}, {"field_id": "topics", "label_zh": "学习主题", "description_zh": "主题名称与覆盖要求，可含每个主题的最低总分钟数。", "question_template": "Which topics must be covered, and are there minimum minutes for each?"}, {"field_id": "priorities", "label_zh": "优先要求", "description_zh": "优先主题及相关硬性时长，或明确无偏好；软偏好不自动计分。", "question_template": "Do you have topic priorities or additional minimum-time requirements?"}]}
